item.title: About
item.description:
I’m currently a bachelor student majoring in electronic and information engineering of advanced manufacturing college of Fuzhou University. My research topics are embedded and AI. In spare time, I like playing piano and reading.

At the third year of the junior high school, I received the guidance of Prof. Yonghao Zheng and Prof. Fucai Liu at University of Electronic Science and Technology of China and did some research on semiconductor and chips.

During the first two years of university, I learned embedded and get the first prize of Fujian province of TI Cup National Undergraduate Electronics Design Contest.
